design: Retain the previous exposures, common valid samples, checkerboard folds and criterion. Multiply the target contrast around its median on common support and keep the reference fixed. The median-centred multiplication avoids modifying the arbitrary pedestal and the fitted intercept absorbs any constant. This is a sensitivity perturbation of aligned real data, not a gain estimate. Unit scale must exactly reproduce every prior fold metric, and outcomes retain all signs and both folds.
